metadata.description: Calibrated RGB8 tensor linear constant-border warp.

WarpAffine RGB8 linear inverse with a constant border (basic). CUBIC reaches the constant border through the restructured fast sampler instead of the border wrap, so LINEAR is benched here because it reads four taps per output, where NEAREST reads one, so the constant-border read is a measurable share of its time; the unroll's effect on NEAREST is carried by the pre-existing NEAREST configs. Interleaved 3-channel LINEAR is the shape VLM preprocessing runs.
WarpAffine uchar4 planar NCHW tensor-only (RGBA8p varshape unsupported by the Python image API) (RGB-standard).
